hooks.name: Failsafe guard on save
hooks.description: Fails on a merge endpoint or command, or a token flowing into a log or audit call, in necromancer, inquisitor and mcp code (failsafe rules 2 and 8).

hooks.name: Failsafe guard on save (Kiro Web, PostToolUse)
hooks.description: Fails on a merge endpoint or command, or a token flowing into a log or audit call, in necromancer, inquisitor and mcp code (failsafe rules 2 and 8). Twin for Kiro Web, which has no File Save trigger.
